overview: 针对图形用户界面（GUI）代理在训练环境成本高和任务稀缺方面的挑战，本文提出了MAI-Gym平台。该平台统一了移动端、桌面端及网页端的GUI代理评估、数据采集与在线强化学习训练。MAI-Gym支持多达20,000个并行环境实例，并能自动合成多样化应用与任务。作者声称，通过该平台训练的MAI-Gym-9B模型在多个基准测试中表现出色，且其实际模拟训练成果已成功迁移至真实手机应用中。

highlights.text: MAI-Gym提供了一个集成平台，支持移动、桌面及网页端的GUI代理评估与在线强化学习训练，并可扩展至20,000个并行环境实例。
highlights.evidence: MAI-Gym, an open all-in-one platform that unifies GUI agent evaluation, data collection, and online RL training across mobile, computer, and web environments. Through a shared rollout pipeline, MAI-Gym ensures consistent agent behavior across evaluation and training, supports ten established benchmarks, and scales to 20,000 parallel environment instances.

highlights.text: MAI-Gym-9B在10B参数以下的开源GUI代理中达到领先水平，且在模拟环境中的训练效果可有效迁移至真实设备。
highlights.evidence: Using MAI-Gym, we train MAI-Gym-9B, a unified 9B agent for mobile and computer use, achieving state-of-the-art performance among open GUI agents under 10B parameters: 78.4% on MobileWorld and 76.2% on OSWorld-Verified. Importantly, RL in a mocked train-ticketing app transfers to its real-world counterpart, improving task success on a phys- ical phone from 28.8% to 48.1%.
